script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       x.id,
       x.organization_id,
       x.picking_id,
       x.job_status,
       x.progress_percent,
       x.progress_message,
       x.attempt_count,
       x.next_attempt_at,
       x.lease_owner,
       x.lease_expires_at,
       x.dead_lease,
       x.row_version,
       x.error_code,
       x.error_message,
       x.error_details,
       x.claim_id,
       x.claim_started_at,
       x.claim_owner
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
                    j.organization_id,
                    j.picking_id,
                    j.job_status,
                    j.progress_percent,
                    j.progress_message,
                    j.attempt_count,
                    DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
                    j.lease_owner,
                    DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
                    (j.lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND j.lease_owner <> '' AND j.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND j.lease_expires_at <= NOW(3)) AS dead_lease,
                    j.row_version,
                    j.error_code,
                    j.error_message,
                    j.error_details,
                    CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS claim_id,
                    DATE_FORMAT(c.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS claim_started_at,
                    c.result_ref AS claim_owner,
                    j.create_time AS created
               FROM gd_async_job j
               LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step c
                 ON c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PWguard.data.tenantId}}'
                AND c.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                AND c.step_name = (CONCAT('W0_CLAIM_', j.row_version) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                AND c.is_deleted = 0
              WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PWguard.data.tenantId}}'
                AND j.is_deleted = 0
                AND j.command = 'CONFIRM_PICKING'
                AND ({{node:code_node_PWguard.data.jobId}} = 0 OR j.id = {{node:code_node_PWguard.data.jobId}})
                AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_PICKING')
                AND (j.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR j.lease_expires_at <= NOW(3))
                AND (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= NOW(3))
                AND (c.id IS NULL OR c.started_at <= NOW(3) - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)
              ORDER BY j.create_time, j.id
              LIMIT 5) x
    ON 1 = 1

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.picking_id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       (j.lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND j.lease_owner <> '' AND j.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND j.lease_expires_at <= n.t) AS dead_lease,
       (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t) AS due_now,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       CAST(cw.id AS CHAR) AS claim_id,
       DATE_FORMAT(cw.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS claim_started_at,
       cw.result_ref AS claim_owner,
       (cw.id IS NOT NULL AND cw.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS claim_live
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PWguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
   AND j.id IN ({{node:code_node_PWplan.data.jobIdsSql}})
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step cw
    ON cw.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PWguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND cw.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cw.step_name = (CONCAT('W0_CLAIM_', j.row_version) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cw.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       j.picking_id,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS finished_at
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PWguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_PWpick.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.attempt_count,
       j.lease_owner,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.picking_id,
       -- only an open force complete has edits to kick; they are read through the open-job states (an index on job_status)
       CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.operation')) = 'FORCE_COMPLETE'
             AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_PICKING')
            THEN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CAST(e.id AS CHAR) ORDER BY e.id)
                    FROM gd_async_job e
                   WHERE e.tenant_id = j.tenant_id
                     AND e.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_GD', 'HELD')
                     AND (e.job_status <> 'HELD' OR e.next_attempt_at <= NOW(3))
                     AND (e.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR e.lease_expires_at <= NOW(3))
                     AND e.is_deleted = 0 AND e.command = 'EDIT_GD' AND e.causation_id = 'PICKING_FC'
                     AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.request_payload, '$.causation_job_id')) AS UNSIGNED) = j.id)
       END AS kick
  FROM gd_async_job j
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PWguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id IN ({{node:code_node_PWplan.data.jobIdsSql}})
